turns.content: In the rest frame of glass with refractive index n and c=1, state the light speed inside the medium.
State the collinear relativistic velocity-addition law needed to transform that speed to the laboratory frame.
If the glass moves at speed v in the same direction as the beam, write the laboratory speed in terms of the glass-frame speed u' and v.
Substitute the working glass-frame speed from the preceding derivation, simplify the expression, and check the corresponding stationary-medium and vacuum-medium limits.
Check the propagation direction using the sign convention established earlier and verify that the result is consistent with the physical setting.
Report the speed and its two limiting cases.
